Remark
[Complete integrals depend on all $n$ parameters] ↗ def:complete-integral 1. ch3:3.1.1-rem-1\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

The rank condition excludes a nonzero direction $b\in \R ^n$ for which $D_a u\cdot b$ vanishes identically in $x$; differentiating such an identity would put $b$ in the kernel of the displayed matrix.
